decisions.reason: A multi-model formwork profile line close to the core offer, with its own page in an expanding firm, meets aspirations and is easily carried by available slack.
Automated flow control fits the firm's automation strategy and growing industry demand, so although it is only mentioned on the website, slack and the strategic fit justify keeping it.
The shuttering magnet line is a core consumable for precast plants, has no signal of shortfall, and costs little to keep in an expanding firm.
Magnetic formwork strips with several models and a dedicated page appear to perform satisfactorily, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
A magnetic formwork component with its own page, close to established offerings, likely meets aspirations given industry growth.
This single component is only mentioned on the website and may be consolidated, but the firm's expansion and slack make dropping it within a year unlikely.
